clips.title: The story
paras: After the fighting at Dun Algaz, Report to Captain Stoutfist sends proven fighters into Menethil Harbor's keep. The harbor is an Alliance military post, where Valstag Ironjaw directs you to Captain Stoutfist as the Dragonmaw threat spreads across the Wetlands.

Dwarven mountaineers have watched the narrow passes of Dun Algaz for years. The Dragonmaw clan's return reaches beyond Loch Modan, though, as the orcs push outward, raise encampments, and threaten the marshlands. Valstag Ironjaw knows that holding the pass is only the first step in protecting the road to Ironforge.

Captain Stoutfist oversees Menethil Harbor's defenses from the war room inside Menethil Keep. Dark Iron saboteurs, local beasts, and marsh murlocs all threaten the port, so the captain depends on capable volunteers to counter dangers beyond the walls. Valstag sends you to carry out direct orders against the Dragonmaw war machine.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend. The Dragonmaw orc clan is showing its strength in more than just Algaz. Captain Stoutfist has asked to speak with those willing to offer aid against these orcs. He is inside the keep, in the war room.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Friend. Valstag briefed me on your past success with the Dragonmaw Orcs at Dun Algaz. You're a traveler of worth.
And I have a task for you.
